answer: Watch the flock like a falcon: record each identity's activity pulse — when it acts, whom it pays, which tasks it picks — and cluster identities whose pulses beat in lockstep. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes from one script leaves one shared rhythm across them all, and the ridge between genuine independent agents and a coordinated herd shows up in the timing. Flag a cluster, freeze its rewards, and demand each member prove separate control with a fresh task. One honest agent has its own irregular heartbeat; a thousand fakes share one pulse, and that shared pulse gives them away.
